_source: Mined read-only from the zeldaret/tww decompilation at Z:/memRip/sources/tww and the ripped GZLE01 (Wind Waker USA) disc data at Z:/3d ripper/out/rip/GZLE01. Final chapter: Ganon's Tower - the four boss rematches behind the trial doors, the maze, Phantom Ganon, Puppet Ganon, the roof, and the ending. Same conventions and schema as ww_story_outset.json and ww_story_fortress.json. Placement data dumped with tools/ww_story_mine.py; event names come from each stage's stage.dzs EVNT table and Stage.arc/event_list.dat. Event-bit ids are authoritative; the UNK_xxxx names are placeholders invented by the decomp team, but this chapter is unusually well named - d_a_obj_vgnfd.cpp carries real names for all eight trial flags.

obj_vgnfd.name: The four trial doors in Ganon's Tower
obj_vgnfd.index_rule: M_door_ev_table, M_boss_ev_table and l_daObjVgnfd_demo_name are three parallel arrays in the same order, so index i is one boss: 0 = Gohma (dn, dragon), 1 = Kalle Demos (mr, mori/woods), 2 = Jalhalla (dc, daichi/earth), 3 = Molgera (kz, kaze/wind). is_door_open(i) reads M_door_ev_table[i]; open_door(i) raises it; is_boss_clear(i) reads M_boss_ev_table[i].

warpgn.name: The warp that carries Link between Ganon's Tower and the Forsaken Fortress
warpgn.gate: UNK_3D02 - the warp is already active when it is set, and the actor raises it at line 407

0x3904.meaning: TRIALS_DOOR_LIGHT_GOHMA - the Gohma trial door in Ganon's Tower is lit and open.

0x3902.meaning: TRIALS_DOOR_LIGHT_KALLE_DEMOS - the Kalle Demos trial door is lit and open.

0x3901.meaning: TRIALS_DOOR_LIGHT_JALHALLA - the Jalhalla trial door is lit and open.

0x3A80.meaning: TRIALS_DOOR_LIGHT_MOLGERA - the Molgera trial door is lit and open.

0x3240.meaning: GOHMA_TRIALS_CLEAR - the Gohma rematch behind the trial door is beaten.
0x3240.set_by: (the rematch boss room; not raised inside d_a_obj_vgnfd.cpp, which only reads it)

0x3220.meaning: KALLE_DEMOS_TRIALS_CLEAR - the Kalle Demos rematch is beaten.

0x3210.meaning: JALHALLA_TRIALS_CLEAR - the Jalhalla rematch is beaten.

0x3208.meaning: MOLGERA_TRIALS_CLEAR - the Molgera rematch is beaten.

0x3204.meaning: All four trials are finished and the final door has opened - daObjVgnfd_c::on_fin raises it right after ordering the "4_door_fin" demo.

0x3D02.meaning: The Ganon's Tower / Forsaken Fortress warp is active. daWarpgn_c skips its appear sequence when it is already set, and raises it once the warp has appeared.

trigger.detail: daWarpgn_c owns the warp between the Forsaken Fortress and Ganon's Tower. It looks up the event indices for TO_MAJYUU_WARP and APPEAR_WARP on create, plays the appear sequence unless UNK_3D02 is already set, and raises UNK_3D02 when the warp has appeared. GanonM's event scripts include both APPEAR_WARP and TO_MAJYUU_WARP. Recorded as kind 'actor': daWarpgn_c resolves the event by NAME through dComIfGp_evmng_getEventIdx, so no trigger volume points at it.

steps.notes: daWarpgn_c is a placed, switch-gated object (it also tests fopAcM_isSwitch at line 511) that resolves its events by name, so nothing in the placement data points at them.

trigger.detail: A TagEv at (4, 1151, 117) with switch 13 orders GanonA's EVNT entry 1 = "Gintro2", the look up at Ganon's Tower as Link enters.

steps.notes: Nothing in src/ references "Gintro2" by name, so the trigger volume is the whole of its wiring.

trigger.detail: Behind the first trial door: the Gohma rematch. daObjVgnfd_c holds three parallel arrays - l_daObjVgnfd_demo_name[0] = "4_door_dn" (dn = dragon), M_door_ev_table[0] = TRIALS_DOOR_LIGHT_GOHMA and M_boss_ev_table[0] = GOHMA_TRIALS_CLEAR - so index 0 is Gohma throughout. is_boss_clear(0) reads the clear flag; open_door(0) raises the door light.

steps.notes: GanonB is 'Ganon's Tower Before Gohma Rematch'; the rematch itself is Xboss0. GanonB has an empty EVNT table and three AttTagB volumes, so its trigger volumes cannot order an event - the boss room does the work. AttTag / AttTagB are a different actor (fpcNm_Tag_Attention_e) and carry NO event index: d_a_tag_attention.h:55-72 decodes only type = (params >> 8) & 0x3 and swSave = params & 0xFF. An earlier draft of this file read them as TagEv volumes; corrected 2026-08-22.

trigger.detail: Index 1 of the same three arrays: "4_door_mr" (mr = mori, the woods), TRIALS_DOOR_LIGHT_KALLE_DEMOS and KALLE_DEMOS_TRIALS_CLEAR. GanonD is the approach; Xboss1 is the rematch.

steps.notes: requires_bits is left listing its own bits deliberately: the four trials can be done in any order, so no trial requires another. The engine reads this step as 'available once its own flags are not yet set'. AttTag / AttTagB are a different actor (fpcNm_Tag_Attention_e) and carry NO event index: d_a_tag_attention.h:55-72 decodes only type = (params >> 8) & 0x3 and swSave = params & 0xFF. An earlier draft of this file read them as TagEv volumes; corrected 2026-08-22.

trigger.detail: When the last of the four is done, daObjVgnfd_c looks up the event index for "4_door_fin" and plays it, then on_fin() raises UNK_3204 (0x3204). That is the final door of the tower opening. Recorded as kind 'bits': it fires as soon as its four requires_bits are all set, which is exactly what daObjVgnfd_c checks.

steps.notes: "4_door_fin" is not in GanonA's stage.dzs EVNT table - the actor resolves it by name through dComIfGp_evmng_getEventIdx, which is why no trigger volume points at it. Its trigger is a pure bit test, so the engine can run it without an actor.

trigger.detail: GanonM room 2 spawn 1 at (-2699, -37, -17) carries EVNT index 2 = "GANON_ARRIVE". Two more spawns in room 0 carry fg_warp0 and fg_warp1 (EVNT 0 and 1), and TagEv volumes with switches 28 and 29 order "Look" and "Look2" on the way in.

steps.notes: GanonM is 'Ganon's Tower Phantom Ganon'. Nothing in src/ names GANON_ARRIVE, so the spawn params are its whole wiring. The 0x3204 requirement is the chapter order, not a gate present in the data.

trigger.detail: GanonK room 0 spawn 0 at (-1, 0, 1424) carries EVNT index 2 = "kugutu_ganon" - kugutu is a puppet. The baked cutscene kugutu_ganon.stb matches. A TagEv with switch 27 orders StartCam2 as Link enters, and four TagEv volumes with switch 14 order WarpCam during the fight. CORRECTION: an earlier draft also counted the AttTag / AttTagB volumes here as ordering WarpCam. AttTag / AttTagB are a different actor (fpcNm_Tag_Attention_e) and carry NO event index: d_a_tag_attention.h:55-72 decodes only type = (params >> 8) & 0x3 and swSave = params & 0xFF. An earlier draft of this file read them as TagEv volumes; corrected 2026-08-22.

trigger.detail: ENDumi ('Ending') has a one-entry EVNT table, "ending", and its single spawn 0 at (-21100, 300, 28300) carries index 0. ending.stb is baked at 2860 frames. The same position is used by ADMumi's tower cutscene spawns, so this is a cutscene-only stage.

steps.notes: epilogue.stb (5225 frames, 17 actors) is also baked but no stage EVNT table names it; what orders it has not been determined.
